messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content:
The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly **2.7 × Jupiter’s radius**, making it the biggest planet ever measured in our galaxy. (Other very large planets, such as WASP‑17b, come close but are slightly smaller.)
